summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG spanning Level 0, the mall, The Hub and authored destinations; player.state carries progression, gear, quests, run choices and resume location. Per-place simulations and generators build local spaces while shared registries and handlers coordinate navigation, NPCs, combat, inventory, story, crafting and synchronized radio stations.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes, anomalies and deterministic dressing; momentsV gates fitted wall moments and room-prop regeneration.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with shops, simulated staff, arcade, homes and salon; authored placements live in cells. places/testlab - Test Range with loot/enemy bays and HIT SQUAD pad.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads, keyed destinations and Camp Amber crews; separate from Bonus room routing, with Level 169 door and destination plaques.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo/ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial office, supplies, encounters and story beats.

places/level1 + places/level4 + places/level26 (3D) - M.E.G. camps and authored office mazes; Level 26's S.S. Fun has cabin 23, Partygoer decks/lockdown and aboard gate; Level 1 includes Dina's radio.

places/level9 + places/level11 + places/level61 (3D) - seeded Suburbs, Level 11 city/Base Beta/strip mall/clinic and Chapter 2 trail, and Snackrooms food court/M.E.G. checkpoint with simulated staff and Clippers lounge.
places/level70 (3D) - winter market/civic town, stalls, hotel, office, pump and Dry Pipes landmarks; sim composes civic, wild and life systems with town/path builders.

places/level169 (3D) - seeded desert hazards, well arrival, Ferry's modeled house/yard/trail, friends, checkpoint road and questline; hosts S.S. Fun landings. places/level10 hosts its other port; Level 5 and Level 7 have world radios.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input actions; fall-guard runs before locomotion/player behavior, with scripts/radio.js on the player.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local config, authored placements and place generation/tick behavior; selected sims compose shared helpers.

places/level169/config.yaml + scripts/terrain169.js + places/level169/sim.js - seeded desert terrain, materials, atmosphere and hazards; versioned setpieces plus YAML-driven house/friends/road, voyage and quest callbacks.

scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - title/settings, new-expedition choices, five-slot save manager and story/tutorial lifecycle; scripts/ui.js composes the in-game HUD and wrist panels.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and per-place zone resolution.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + xmas-room.js + level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic maze dressing/encounters; moments version gates rebuilds.
places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - Hub topology, doors, dressing and crew; Phoebe shares scripts/lib/phoebe.js dressing.

places/level109/sim.js + scripts/lib/level109.js + l109-b3.js + l109-rooms.js + l109-outpost.js + l109-life.js - seeded hospital, room dressing, B3 and outpost actors/behavior; places/level114/sim.js owns Sweet Dreams.
shared: scripts/lib/places.js - canonical per-place names, labels and HUD titles; consumed by feed, quest names and scripts/ui.js.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/caching/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 path adapters.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - common pursuit/lurk/wake/retreat/bite behavior configured by scripts/lib/l34-smiler.js and scripts/lib/l9-smiler.js.
scripts/lib/carry.js + scripts/lib/companion.js - threshold-crossing transfer of held props and nearby following companions; companion recruitment, orders, perks and lifecycle.
scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts and scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - separate Bonus shared-room routing and The Hub tunnel/door/key registry.
scripts/lib/containment.js - Level 109 persistent pen/loose-foe, open-door and remembered-door-position books; sim supplies room IDs/boxes and spawnFoe adapter.

scripts/lib/pg-society.js + scripts/lib/data/pg-society.yml - Level 26 Partygoer role/routes, sight-bound relay and deck alert/search/recovery; scripts/partygoers.js reads rules and owns actor behavior/traps.

scripts/lib/npc-gear.js + scripts/lib/fresh-aura.js - shared NPC leveled gear/wear/pocket rolls and Reality Freshener radius check; meg-agent, hit squads, player and remodel quest reuse these helpers.
notableExports: scripts/lib/grid-path.js - DIRS, createGridPather; per-level path adapters retain level-specific cell/block rules and exports.
scripts/lib/ambush-smiler.js - stepAmbushSmiler; l34-smiler.js and l9-smiler.js expose update with separate configurations.
scripts/lib/companion.js - PERKS, perkOf, isMine, followersOf, loyaltyScale, whyNot, recruit/adopt/dismiss/order, weapon handoff, tick, bring; carry.js - carryAcross.
scripts/lib/ui-kit.js - esc, uiPrefsOf/Attrs, escKeyHandler, emptyState, classifyNotice/noticeToast; scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate.
scripts/lib/quests.js - shared journal/advancement/reward helpers; containment.js - containment state/pen/door operations; ch2-quest.js - Chapter 2 stages and dialogue helpers.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js - OPTS, DEFAULTS, PICK_DEFAULTS, RATE, PRESETS, runOf, needsMul, sanityMul, noStory, noNpcs, cleanPick, KEEP, SKIP; scripts/main-menu.js exports SLOTS.

scripts/lib/radio.js - STATIONS, STATION, stationOf, onAir; scripts/lib/npc-gear.js - NPC_POOLS, refPlayerLevel, npcSpread, npcGearLevel, npcPoolKey, rollNpcWeapon, adaptNpcWear, rollNpcPocketLoot; fresh-aura.js - FRESH_BODY, nearFresh.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable player.state progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep; player.js owns player actions and runtime player behavior.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/stats-ui.js formats derived stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates the xpCurve progression model.

scripts/lib/modifiers.js - player.state bookBonuses/readBooks/genericBooksRead/effects and modifier derivation; scripts/lib/clothes.js owns worn gear records whose passive modifiers feed the modifier engine.

scripts/lib/manuals.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.recipes stores learned recipe IDs; legacy player.state.manuals still grants all recipes of those kinds. Using a manual token learns one unknown recipe of its kind.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - player.state.run owns expedition picks; run options determine story/NPC presence and hunger/thirst/sanity drain multipliers.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - SQL saves table owns named save-slot snapshots by player owner and slot; player.state remains the live/current run state.
scripts/radio.js - player.state.radioOn/radioSt retain tuned station and power; radioOpen is the current wrist-tab state, with stream/hush object IDs kept in session.

scripts/lib/npc-gear.js + NPC actors - NPC state.gearLevel/arm and clothing/pocket rolls; scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js owns player Fresh Paint progress (remodQ, l02got, fresh and related turn-in flags).
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb/crawl, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV and radio behaviors; scripts/interact.js handles tagged-seat selection and script-specific interactions.

templates/player.js runs scripts/fall-guard.js update before movement; place changes hold velocity for ground streaming, grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; body3 uses camera aim + combat-anims.yml for third-person pose.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.
scripts/main-menu-ui.js actions → scripts/main-menu.js → player.state.run or SQL saves; new-run reset uses run-opts KEEP/SKIP, and load resolves destination through wakePlace.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js → main-menu story gates Dina/Chapter 2/cutscenes; global sim.js removes tagged NPCs only when every player in a place chose noNpcs, and Phoebe only when every player chose noStory.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js needsMul → scripts/craft.js hunger/thirst tick; sanityMul → scripts/player.js sanity drain; old saves without choices use legacy DEFAULTS.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; threshold door handlers call carryAcross → held props and nearby following companions cross; Bonus/world/room links are excluded.
scripts/player.js zone resolver → player.state.zone; scripts/lib/places.js → feed, quest labels and scripts/ui.js HUD titles, markers and compass place names.
scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers place-matched jobs; carried items/kills/world events advance errands → journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts.

scripts/talk.js → dialogue.js rootChoices and quest handlers; level quest modules call scripts/lib/quests.js → journal/feed/reputation/reward state; scripts/lib/data/dlg-*.yml supplies character-specific choices and barks.

scripts/radio.js action → player.state.radioOn/radioSt and scripts/radio-ui.js; scripts/lib/radio.js selects synchronized segments from radio*.yml, HALOGEN seeks the tuned station on Radio bus and hushes Music locally, while world radios play station audio.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon + places/level61/sim.js and scripts/lib/level61-extra.js - authored commercial interiors and simulated staff/services; menus/staff vary by venue and Level 6.1 fixtures are fitted separately.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes a table with separately fitted chairs.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/ballistics.js + scripts/lib/knock.js - weapon stats/variants share combat; per-weapon sound/rack/reload fields resolve through sounds.yml, with Squirt Gun liquid effects and variants.

art/cigs/build.py + art/fnv/build.py + art/xmas-clean/build.py and NIF converters, plus art/cat-wardrobe/fit.py + tailclear.py + art/level70-stall/parts.py - fitted GLBs/prop catalogs and body-specific garment/prop fitting.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait selection; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.

Level 01/Zenith and Level 1 geometry builders + scripts/l169-house-geo.js - authored station/car park and Level 169 house geometry; materials, fixtures and house furniture parts vary by configured params.

scripts/lib/npc-gear.js + scripts/lib/clothes.js + weapons/loot registries - NPC weapons, clothing and pockets scale by reference player level, role/faction/pool and stable per-NPC spread; scripts/meg-agent.js and hit squads consume the roll helpers.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

The Hub run frame/coordinates and OPEN/KEYED/SEALED door mapping are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; preserve IDs, destinations and coordinates together. Keyed doors consume player.state.hubKeys.
Level 109 place.state.l109seed fixes irregular corridor/room rolls; containment books are keyed by room ID and remember pen-door positions. Local terminal host/mode and roomId must stay aligned.
Level 26 society state is split by deck in place.state.pgAlert; Partygoer social memory is session-local, bait records are keyed by route stop, and pgLiftLocked controls only the lower lift.

Level 169 uses x/z with north at -z and terrain scale 1:10; keep terrain marks, house/trail geometry, road sites and ship berths aligned. Residents' furniture is laid by scripts/lib/l169-friends.js from level169.yml stops/seats/rolls rather than free placement.

Radio timing is global room-clock time: keep each YAML segment duration aligned to its clip and HALOGEN/world radios seek onAir offsets. STATIONS order defines persisted radioSt; scripts/lib/data/radio-ads.yml's Ad Nauseam AM segment order is intentionally a random jumble of decades, not chronological.
